description: This file defines a singleton object RepositoryProvider that acts as a factory for creating and providing instances of various repository classes such as ProfileRepository, ConnectionRepository, and TransferHistoryRepository. It encapsulates the logic for instantiating these repositories, some of which are backed by SharedPreferences and others by Room database components.

methods.name: profileRepository
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of ProfileRepository backed by SharedPreferences.

methods.name: connectionRepository
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of ConnectionRepository backed by Room database.

methods.name: transferHistoryRepository
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an instance of TransferHistoryRepository backed by Room database.
